review: RG-02, MD-01..06: primary projectile profiles in unit_combat.cpp apply laser, missile, torpedo, ion and mass-driver damage/guidance; mass drivers bypass shields and use authored hull/hardpoint armor factors. The seven stock mass-driver carrier profiles and both effect-only projectile models are covered by game-data contracts. WAD-01..30: the blast service applies authored damage/range, tiered falloff, faction immunity, direct-route exclusion and secondary hull/hardpoint delivery; WAD-04 rocket flight supplies Diamond Boron termination. Weapon special hardpoints remain excluded. RG-03: ability_table dispatches the listed kinds and rejects other modifiers. WHE-22/23/51/52: active cause/take damage modes feed ordinary damage at delivery; Falcon uses ordinary expiration/recharge and the authored invulnerability emitter. Movement profiles implement the three listed locomotors. Skirmish uses Tech_0 carrier lists; higher-tech lists and minor registry gaps do not gate ships. G7 WHE-26/27/57..60: named energy/tractor handlers service tracked ship targets, ordinary range geometry, direct per-frame damage and source/category speed removal; unknown U-09 sub-policies use conservative defaults. G8 WHE-28/29/61/62: authored spawned types, countdown detonation and source-owned timed category-0 weaken effects; conservative placement, no automatic selection or cancellation of created objects. BARR-01/WAD-38: Broadside and Marauder BARRAGE binds the enemy proxy, override projectile, 10/40-second timers, fire-rate multiplier 3, fixed scatter 320 and height offset -150; the HUD sends a world-point area command and retains ordinary cancellation. G9 WHE-30/63/64: retain leader and authored survivor order, append until authored total, recharge only on refill, and route raw ordinary and privileged damage before recipient modes. WAB-04/05/50..56: HUNT patrol core clears attacks, services idle leaders with deterministic fog/enemy/fallback destinations, commits coordinated attack-moves and cancels accepted orders; fire/camera/order-gate limits remain tracked separately.

ability_only_hardpoints.HP_KEDALBE_SHIELD_LEECH_00: No Fire_Projectile_Type; its only action is the disabled LEECH_SHIELDS ability. This does not prevent ordinary weapons from firing (RG-03).
